description: The Chinese Academy of Forestry publishes Temperature Vegetation Dryness Index maps for the Mongolian Plateau during 1981–2018. The collection includes annual maps and monthly maps for April through October. Grid resolution changes from eight kilometres in 1981–1999 to one kilometre in 2000–2018, with Lambert azimuthal equal-area projection. ScienceDB repository states CC BY 4.0 for free reuse but does not identify the raster container in its inspected description. These indices can define spatial drought scenarios for agricultural-water and vegetation simulations. The resolution change limits direct pixelwise trend comparisons, and TVDI is an inferred dryness indicator, not measured soil-water content. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: A dataset of drought degree monitoring in the Mongolian Plateau from 1981 to 2018
